nodes.label: Strict dependency direction between internal packages
nodes.community_name: internal/provider — SSE reader, error taxonomy, catalog, 3 codecs, retry, registry
nodes.norm_label: strict dependency direction between internal packages
nodes.rationale: Leaf packages import nothing internal and mutually independent packages never import each other, so the graph stays acyclic and any package can be tested in isolation.

nodes.label: history replay — verbatim thinking only for the same model + signature
nodes.community_name: internal/provider — SSE reader, error taxonomy, catalog, 3 codecs, retry, registry
nodes.norm_label: history replay — verbatim thinking only for the same model + signature
nodes.rationale: Signatures and encrypted reasoning payloads are bound to the producing model; replaying them elsewhere or unsigned is a 400 on every later turn, so unmatched blocks degrade to [prior reasoning] text.

nodes.label: path jail does not apply to MCP tools
nodes.community_name: internal/provider — SSE reader, error taxonomy, catalog, 3 codecs, retry, registry
nodes.norm_label: path jail does not apply to mcp tools
nodes.rationale: A server has its own scope, and its calls/results are ordinary tool calls for sessions, snapshots and compaction.

nodes.label: model overrides merge rather than replace catalog entries
nodes.community_name: internal/provider — SSE reader, error taxonomy, catalog, 3 codecs, retry, registry
nodes.norm_label: model overrides merge rather than replace catalog entries
nodes.rationale: A config entry for a catalog model should tweak only the fields it sets, so users can correct a price or window without re-declaring the whole row; NewRegistry fails fast with the exact key path when required fields are missing.
